_note: Static reference of every known achievement category, line, and capstone — name + description only. Per-tier thresholds and rewards are NOT included: the game only ever exposes the next uncompleted tiers reward/threshold for a given account, never the full bronze/silver/gold/crown ladder, so there is no static ladder to capture here. See src/background/features/achievements/achievementsPanelParser.ts for the live parser that reads an accounts actual tier/progress/ready state at runtime.
